verdict.rationale: Exporting your own records is a fair question for an online account service like the IRS portal, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only lists a bare 'Tax record (transcript)' title, with nothing documenting bulk export of all account data or any open format. The MeF XML evidence covers inbound filing by credentialed providers, not user data export, so it does not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
